title: Osteoinductive chemically crosslinked hydrogel enables hydroxyapatite formation, enhanced by release of dexamethasone, strontium, and zinc, and exhibits antimicrobial properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18666-18678
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09258B, Paper
Open Access

Benjamin Gambrill, Lirong Yang, Polina Prokopovich
Injectable hydrogels have the ability to bridge sites of bone fractures, favouring bone regeneration processes such as osteoinduction followed by osteoconduction, thereby restoring bone functions in terms of structural stability and support.
